{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = df_clean['severity'].value_counts().get('severe', 0)
total_patients = len(df_clean)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Number of severe patients: {severe_count}")
print(f"Total patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
